facts.fact: According to a third-party Omnisend statistic cited by StackAdapt, marketers using three or more channels in a campaign earned a 494% higher order rate than marketers using a single channel.
facts.quote: marketers using three or more channels in a campaign earned a [494% higher order rate](https://www.omnisend.com/blog/omnichannel-statistics/) than marketers using a single channel.

facts.fact: The page describes omnichannel marketing automation as following a "crawl, walk, run" approach, in which manual processes are used first to validate concepts before they are automated to scale.
facts.quote: This example illustrates omnichannel marketing automation’s “crawl, walk, run” approach. Starting with manual processes helps validate concepts and that they resonate with the target audience.
